TITLE: Tech View / Board View – Padlock Shows No Tooltip on Hover, Only the Browser's Plain Hint
STATUS: FILING APPROVED by the QA lead 26 Oct 2026 ("Yes do file the report for this if it is going against the PRD/design", parent SV-11593, test on sv11500); re-checked on sv11500 08:45 UTC first. Earlier: HELD — prepared 26 Oct 2026. QA lead chose (A) on 26 Oct: "mark the test Failed and prepare a ticket for your go-ahead, filed under fast follow". File only on his per-ticket yes (Rule 113).
Fields (on approval): Bug · parent SV-11593 (Board/Tech View Fast Follow) · Medium · Product Area Work Orders · labels board-tech-view, fast-follow · relates to SV-10047 (Story 4)

h2. Description

*What the PRD requires:* the padlock after an Invoiced or Paid work order's number has a *tooltip* carrying the locked words (PRD *S4-N6*: "The same words are the tooltip on the card’s or row’s lock icon"). The design draws its tooltips as a dark box with light text, opening above what is hovered — the same style the app already uses for the display switcher.

*What happens instead:* resting the mouse on the padlock opens no tooltip. Only the browser's own plain hint appears after a delay, in the browser's style, not the app's.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in, open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab and click *Tech View*.
# Find a row whose work order is *Invoiced* (a small padlock sits right after the number).
# Rest the mouse on the padlock.
#* No dark tooltip opens above the padlock.
#* As a check, rest the mouse on *Board View* in the display switcher: a dark tooltip with light text opens.

*Actual Result:*

* No tooltip opens on the padlock; only the browser's plain hint appears.

*Expected Result:*

* A tooltip opens above the padlock, in the app's dark tooltip style, with the locked words.
